cues.passage: From high above, a grey plain covered in craters. One large crater is ringed with boulders. Nothing moves.
cues.arrival: The lunar module Eagle flies above the Moon, gold foil shining in hard sunlight. Its engine points down. The ground is far below.
cues.alarm: Close on Eagle in flight. A yellow light marked PROG is on, on the small computer keyboard inside.
cues.boulders: From behind Eagle, looking ahead. The path leads into a big crater full of boulders as large as cars. Smooth ground lies beyond it.
cues.flight: Eagle flies west, low over the crater, tilting to hold its speed.
cues.touchdown: Eagle comes down the last few meters. Dust shoots out sideways in flat, straight lines. Then everything is still.
cues.landed: Eagle stands on the Moon. Its four legs rest on grey dust. The Sun is low and the shadows are very long. The sky is black.
cues.discovery: Seen from the south: Eagle, a flag, and two small instruments set on the ground a short walk away.
cues.stage: Close on the lower half of Eagle: an eight-sided box wrapped in gold foil, with four legs and a ladder.
cues.lrrr: A flat square tray, tilted toward the sky, covered with small round mirrors. No wire leads to it.
cues.psep: A low box with two solar panels like open wings, and a thin antenna.
cues.liftoff: The top half of Eagle lifts off without smoke or flame. The blast knocks the flag over. The lower half stays.
cues.desolation: The lower half of Eagle stands alone on the plain. The flag lies in the dust. Nothing has moved here since 1969.
cues.clew: The mirror tray again, very close. It has no cable, no battery, no solar panel.
cues.status: Straight down from orbit: craters, and one small bright dot with a long shadow. That dot is Eagle's lower half.
cues.file: The lower half of Eagle turns slowly so you can see every side.
